rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_OPM_HDCP_SRM_NEVER_SET
rows.description: IOPMVideoOutput's GetInformation() method cannot return the version of the SRM being used because the application never successfully passed an SRM to the video output.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_OPM_RESOLUTION_TOO_HIGH
rows.description: IOPMVideoOutput's Configure() method cannot enable the specified output protection technology because the output's screen resolution is too high.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_OPM_ALL_HDCP_HARDWARE_ALREADY_IN_USE
rows.description: IOPMVideoOutput's Configure() method cannot enable HDCP because the display adapter's HDCP hardware is already being used by other physical outputs.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_OPM_VIDEO_OUTPUT_NO_LONGER_EXISTS
rows.description: The operating system asynchronously destroyed this OPM video output because the operating system's state changed. This error typically occurs because the monitor physical device object (PDO) associated with this video output was removed, the monitor PDO associated with this video output was stopped, the video output's session became a nonconsole session or the video output's desktop became an inactive desktop.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_OPM_SESSION_TYPE_CHANGE_IN_PROGRESS
rows.description: IOPMVideoOutput's methods cannot be called when a session is changing its type. There are currently three types of sessions: console, disconnected and remote (remote desktop protocol [RDP] or Independent Computing Architecture [ICA]).

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_MCA_MONITOR_VIOLATES_MCCS_SPECIFICATION

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_MCA_MCCS_VERSION_MISMATCH

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_MCA_UNSUPPORTED_MCCS_VERSION

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_MCA_INVALID_TECHNOLOGY_TYPE_RETURNED
rows.description: The monitor returned an invalid monitor technology type. CRT, plasma, and LCD (TFT) are examples of monitor technology types. This error implies that the monitor violated the MCCS 2.0 or MCCS 2.0 Revision 1 specification.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_MCA_UNSUPPORTED_COLOR_TEMPERATURE
rows.description: The SetMonitorColorTemperature() caller passed a color temperature to it that the current monitor did not support. CRT, plasma, and LCD (TFT) are examples of monitor technology types. This error implies that the monitor violated the MCCS 2.0 or MCCS 2.0 Revision 1 specification.

rows.name: ERROR_GRAPHICS_ONLY_CONSOLE_SESSION_SUPPORTED

rows.name: STATUS_FILE_CORRUPT_ERROR
rows.description: {Corrupt File} The file or directory %hs is corrupt and unreadable. Run the Chkdsk utility.

rows.name: STATUS_NOT_A_DIRECTORY
rows.description: A requested opened file is not a directory.

rows.name: STATUS_BAD_LOGON_SESSION_STATE
rows.description: The logon session is not in a state that is consistent with the requested operation.

rows.name: STATUS_LOGON_SESSION_COLLISION
rows.description: An internal LSA error has occurred. An authentication package has requested the creation of a logon session but the ID of an already existing logon session has been specified.

rows.name: STATUS_NAME_TOO_LONG
rows.description: A specified name string is too long for its intended use.

rows.name: STATUS_FILES_OPEN
rows.description: The user attempted to force close the files on a redirected drive, but there were opened files on the drive, and the user did not specify a sufficient level of force.

rows.name: STATUS_CONNECTION_IN_USE
rows.description: The user attempted to force close the files on a redirected drive, but there were opened directories on the drive, and the user did not specify a sufficient level of force.

rows.name: STATUS_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: RtlFindMessage could not locate the requested message ID in the message table resource.

rows.name: STATUS_PROCESS_IS_TERMINATING
rows.description: An attempt was made to duplicate an object handle into or out of an exiting process.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LOGON_TYPE
rows.description: Indicates an invalid value has been provided for the LogonType requested.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_GUID_TRANSLATION
rows.description: Indicates that an attempt was made to assign protection to a file system file or directory and one of the SIDs in the security descriptor could not be translated into a GUID that could be stored by the file system. This causes the protection attempt to fail, which might cause a file creation attempt to fail.

rows.name: STATUS_CANNOT_IMPERSONATE
rows.description: Indicates that an attempt has been made to impersonate via a named pipe that has not yet been read from.

rows.name: STATUS_IMAGE_ALREADY_LOADED
rows.description: Indicates that the specified image is already loaded.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_LDT
rows.description: Indicates that an attempt was made to change the size of the LDT for a process that has no LDT.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LDT_SIZE
rows.description: Indicates that an attempt was made to grow an LDT by setting its size, or that the size was not an even number of selectors.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LDT_OFFSET
rows.description: Indicates that the starting value for the LDT information was not an integral multiple of the selector size.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LDT_DESCRIPTOR
rows.description: Indicates that the user supplied an invalid descriptor when trying to set up LDT descriptors.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_NE_FORMAT
rows.description: The specified image file did not have the correct format. It appears to be NE format.

rows.name: STATUS_RXACT_INVALID_STATE
rows.description: Indicates that the transaction state of a registry subtree is incompatible with the requested operation. For example, a request has been made to start a new transaction with one already in progress, or a request has been made to apply a transaction when one is not currently in progress.

rows.name: STATUS_RXACT_COMMIT_FAILURE
rows.description: Indicates an error has occurred during a registry transaction commit. The database has been left in an unknown, but probably inconsistent, state. The state of the registry transaction is left as COMMITTING.

rows.name: STATUS_MAPPED_FILE_SIZE_ZERO
rows.description: An attempt was made to map a file of size zero with the maximum size specified as zero.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_OPENED_FILES
rows.description: Too many files are opened on a remote server. This error should only be returned by the Windows redirector on a remote drive.

rows.name: STATUS_CANCELLED
rows.description: The I/O request was canceled.

rows.name: STATUS_CANNOT_DELETE
rows.description: An attempt has been made to remove a file or directory that cannot be deleted.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_COMPUTER_NAME
rows.description: Indicates a name that was specified as a remote computer name is syntactically invalid.

rows.name: STATUS_FILE_DELETED
rows.description: An I/O request other than close was performed on a file after it was deleted, which can only happen to a request that did not complete before the last handle was closed via NtClose.

rows.name: STATUS_SPECIAL_ACCOUNT
rows.description: Indicates an operation that is incompatible with built-in accounts has been attempted on a built-in (special) SAM account. For example, built-in accounts cannot be deleted.

rows.name: STATUS_SPECIAL_GROUP
rows.description: The operation requested cannot be performed on the specified group because it is a built-in special group.

rows.name: STATUS_SPECIAL_USER
rows.description: The operation requested cannot be performed on the specified user because it is a built-in special user.

rows.name: STATUS_MEMBERS_PRIMARY_GROUP
rows.description: Indicates a member cannot be removed from a group because the group is currently the member's primary group.

rows.name: STATUS_FILE_CLOSED
rows.description: An I/O request other than close and several other special case operations was attempted using a file object that had already been closed.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_THREADS
rows.description: Indicates a process has too many threads to perform the requested action. For example, assignment of a primary token can be performed only when a process has zero or one threads.

rows.name: STATUS_THREAD_NOT_IN_PROCESS
rows.description: An attempt was made to operate on a thread within a specific process, but the specified thread is not in the specified process.

rows.name: STATUS_TOKEN_ALREADY_IN_USE
rows.description: An attempt was made to establish a token for use as a primary token but the token is already in use. A token can only be the primary token of one process at a time.

rows.name: STATUS_PAGEFILE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
rows.description: The page file quota was exceeded.

rows.name: STATUS_COMMITMENT_LIMIT
rows.description: {Out of Virtual Memory} Your system is low on virtual memory. To ensure that Windows runs correctly, increase the size of your virtual memory paging file. For more information, see Help.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_LE_FORMAT
rows.description: The specified image file did not have the correct format: it appears to be LE format.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_NOT_MZ
rows.description: The specified image file did not have the correct format: it did not have an initial MZ.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_PROTECT
rows.description: The specified image file did not have the correct format: it did not have a proper e_lfarlc in the MZ header.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_WIN_16
rows.description: The specified image file did not have the correct format: it appears to be a 16-bit Windows image.

rows.name: STATUS_LOGON_SERVER_CONFLICT
rows.description: The Netlogon service cannot start because another Netlogon service running in the domain conflicts with the specified role.

rows.name: STATUS_TIME_DIFFERENCE_AT_DC
rows.description: The time at the primary domain controller is different from the time at the backup domain controller or member server by too large an amount.

rows.name: STATUS_SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUIRED
rows.description: On applicable Windows Server releases, the SAM database is significantly out of synchronization with the copy on the domain controller. A complete synchronization is required.

rows.name: STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: {Unable To Locate Component} This application has failed to start because %hs was not found. Reinstalling the application might fix this problem.

rows.name: STATUS_OPEN_FAILED
rows.description: The NtCreateFile API failed. This error should never be returned to an application; it is a place holder for the Windows LAN Manager Redirector to use in its internal error-mapping routines.

rows.name: STATUS_IO_PRIVILEGE_FAILED
rows.description: {Privilege Failed} The I/O permissions for the process could not be changed.

rows.name: STATUS_ORDINAL_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: {Ordinal Not Found} The ordinal %ld could not be located in the dynamic link library %hs.

rows.name: STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: {Entry Point Not Found} The procedure entry point %hs could not be located in the dynamic link library %hs.

rows.name: STATUS_CONTROL_C_EXIT
rows.description: {Application Exit by CTRL+C} The application terminated as a result of a CTRL+C.

rows.name: STATUS_LOCAL_DISCONNECT
rows.description: {Virtual Circuit Closed} The network transport on your computer has closed a network connection. There might or might not be I/O requests outstanding.

rows.name: STATUS_REMOTE_DISCONNECT
rows.description: {Virtual Circuit Closed} The network transport on a remote computer has closed a network connection. There might or might not be I/O requests outstanding.

rows.name: STATUS_REMOTE_RESOURCES
rows.description: {Insufficient Resources on Remote Computer} The remote computer has insufficient resources to complete the network request. For example, the remote computer might not have enough available memory to carry out the request at this time.

rows.name: STATUS_LINK_FAILED
rows.description: {Virtual Circuit Closed} An existing connection (virtual circuit) has been broken at the remote computer. There is probably something wrong with the network software protocol or the network hardware on the remote computer.

rows.name: STATUS_LINK_TIMEOUT
rows.description: {Virtual Circuit Closed} The network transport on your computer has closed a network connection because it had to wait too long for a response from the remote computer.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_CONNECTION
rows.description: The connection handle that was given to the transport was invalid.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_ADDRESS
rows.description: The address handle that was given to the transport was invalid.

rows.name: STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED
rows.description: {DLL Initialization Failed} Initialization of the dynamic link library %hs failed. The process is terminating abnormally.

rows.name: STATUS_MISSING_SYSTEMFILE
rows.description: {Missing System File} The required system file %hs is bad or missing.

rows.name: STATUS_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION
rows.description: {Application Error} The exception %s (0x%08lx) occurred in the application at location 0x%08lx.

rows.name: STATUS_APP_INIT_FAILURE
rows.description: {Application Error} The application failed to initialize properly (0x%lx). Click OK to terminate the application.

rows.name: STATUS_PAGEFILE_CREATE_FAILED
rows.description: {Unable to Create Paging File} The creation of the paging file %hs failed (%lx). The requested size was %ld.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_PAGEFILE
rows.description: {No Paging File Specified} No paging file was specified in the system configuration.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LEVEL
rows.description: {Incorrect System Call Level} An invalid level was passed into the specified system call.

rows.name: STATUS_WRONG_PASSWORD_CORE
rows.description: {Incorrect Password to LAN Manager Server} You specified an incorrect password to a LAN Manager 2.x or MS-NET server.

rows.name: STATUS_ILLEGAL_FLOAT_CONTEXT
rows.description: {EXCEPTION} A real-mode application issued a floating-point instruction and floating-point hardware is not present.

rows.name: STATUS_PIPE_BROKEN
rows.description: The pipe operation has failed because the other end of the pipe has been closed.

rows.name: STATUS_REGISTRY_CORRUPT
rows.description: {The Registry Is Corrupt} The structure of one of the files that contains registry data is corrupt; the image of the file in memory is corrupt; or the file could not be recovered because the alternate copy or log was absent or corrupt.

rows.name: STATUS_REGISTRY_IO_FAILED
rows.description: An I/O operation initiated by the Registry failed and cannot be recovered. The registry could not read in, write out, or flush one of the files that contain the system's image of the registry.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_EVENT_PAIR
rows.description: An event pair synchronization operation was performed using the thread-specific client/server event pair object, but no event pair object was associated with the thread.

rows.name: STATUS_UNRECOGNIZED_VOLUME
rows.description: The volume does not contain a recognized file system. Be sure that all required file system drivers are loaded and that the volume is not corrupt.

rows.name: STATUS_SERIAL_NO_DEVICE_INITED
rows.description: No serial device was successfully initialized. The serial driver will unload.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_SUCH_ALIAS
rows.description: The specified local group does not exist.

rows.name: STATUS_MEMBER_NOT_IN_ALIAS
rows.description: The specified account name is not a member of the group.

rows.name: STATUS_MEMBER_IN_ALIAS
rows.description: The specified account name is already a member of the group.

rows.name: STATUS_ALIAS_EXISTS
rows.description: The specified local group already exists.

rows.name: STATUS_LOGON_NOT_GRANTED
rows.description: A requested type of logon (for example, interactive, network, and service) is not granted by the local security policy of the target system. Ask the system administrator to grant the necessary form of logon.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_SECRETS
rows.description: The maximum number of secrets that can be stored in a single system was exceeded. The length and number of secrets is limited to satisfy U.S. State Department export restrictions.

rows.name: STATUS_SECRET_TOO_LONG
rows.description: The length of a secret exceeds the maximum allowable length. The length and number of secrets is limited to satisfy U.S. State Department export restrictions.

rows.name: STATUS_INTERNAL_DB_ERROR
rows.description: The local security authority (LSA) database contains an internal inconsistency.

rows.name: STATUS_FULLSCREEN_MODE
rows.description: The requested operation cannot be performed in full-screen mode.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_CONTEXT_IDS
rows.description: During a logon attempt, the user's security context accumulated too many security IDs. This is a very unusual situation. Remove the user from some global or local groups to reduce the number of security IDs to incorporate into the security context.

rows.name: STATUS_LOGON_TYPE_NOT_GRANTED
rows.description: A user has requested a type of logon (for example, interactive or network) that has not been granted. An administrator has control over who can logon interactively and through the network.

rows.name: STATUS_NOT_REGISTRY_FILE
rows.description: The system has attempted to load or restore a file into the registry, and the specified file is not in the format of a registry file.

rows.name: STATUS_NT_CROSS_ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED
rows.description: An attempt was made to change a user password in the security account manager without providing the necessary Windows cross-encrypted password.

rows.name: STATUS_DOMAIN_CTRLR_CONFIG_ERROR
rows.description: A domain server has an incorrect configuration.

rows.name: STATUS_FT_MISSING_MEMBER
rows.description: An attempt was made to explicitly access the secondary copy of information via a device control to the fault tolerance driver and the secondary copy is not present in the system.

rows.name: STATUS_ILL_FORMED_SERVICE_ENTRY
rows.description: A configuration registry node that represents a driver service entry was ill-formed and did not contain the required value entries.

rows.name: STATUS_ILLEGAL_CHARACTER
rows.description: An illegal character was encountered. For a multibyte character set, this includes a lead byte without a succeeding trail byte. For the Unicode character set this includes the characters 0xFFFF and 0xFFFE.

rows.name: STATUS_UNMAPPABLE_CHARACTER
rows.description: No mapping for the Unicode character exists in the target multibyte code page.

rows.name: STATUS_UNDEFINED_CHARACTER
rows.description: The Unicode character is not defined in the Unicode character set that is installed on the system.

rows.name: STATUS_FLOPPY_VOLUME
rows.description: The paging file cannot be created on a floppy disk.

rows.name: STATUS_FLOPPY_ID_MARK_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: {Floppy Disk Error} While accessing a floppy disk, an ID address mark was not found.

rows.name: STATUS_FLOPPY_WRONG_CYLINDER
rows.description: {Floppy Disk Error} While accessing a floppy disk, the track address from the sector ID field was found to be different from the track address that is maintained by the controller.

rows.name: STATUS_FLOPPY_UNKNOWN_ERROR
rows.description: {Floppy Disk Error} The floppy disk controller reported an error that is not recognized by the floppy disk driver.

rows.name: STATUS_FLOPPY_BAD_REGISTERS
rows.description: {Floppy Disk Error} While accessing a floppy-disk, the controller returned inconsistent results via its registers.

rows.name: STATUS_DISK_RECALIBRATE_FAILED
rows.description: {Hard Disk Error} While accessing the hard disk, a recalibrate operation failed, even after retries.

rows.name: STATUS_DISK_OPERATION_FAILED
rows.description: {Hard Disk Error} While accessing the hard disk, a disk operation failed even after retries.

rows.name: STATUS_DISK_RESET_FAILED
rows.description: {Hard Disk Error} While accessing the hard disk, a disk controller reset was needed, but even that failed.

rows.name: STATUS_SHARED_IRQ_BUSY
rows.description: An attempt was made to open a device that was sharing an interrupt request (IRQ) with other devices. At least one other device that uses that IRQ was already opened. Two concurrent opens of devices that share an IRQ and only work via interrupts is not supported for the particular bus type that the devices use.

rows.name: STATUS_FT_ORPHANING
rows.description: {FT Orphaning} A disk that is part of a fault-tolerant volume can no longer be accessed.

rows.name: STATUS_BIOS_FAILED_TO_CONNECT_INTERRUPT
rows.description: The basic input/output system (BIOS) failed to connect a system interrupt to the device or bus for which the device is connected.

rows.name: STATUS_PARTITION_FAILURE
rows.description: The tape could not be partitioned.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_BLOCK_LENGTH
rows.description: When accessing a new tape of a multi-volume partition, the current blocksize is incorrect.

rows.name: STATUS_DEVICE_NOT_PARTITIONED
rows.description: The tape partition information could not be found when loading a tape.

rows.name: STATUS_UNABLE_TO_LOCK_MEDIA
rows.description: An attempt to lock the eject media mechanism failed.

rows.name: STATUS_UNABLE_TO_UNLOAD_MEDIA
rows.description: An attempt to unload media failed.

rows.name: STATUS_EOM_OVERFLOW
rows.description: The physical end of tape was detected.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_MEDIA
rows.description: {No Media} There is no media in the drive. Insert media into drive %hs.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_SUCH_MEMBER
rows.description: A member could not be added to or removed from the local group because the member does not exist.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_MEMBER
rows.description: A new member could not be added to a local group because the member has the wrong account type.

rows.name: STATUS_KEY_DELETED
rows.description: An illegal operation was attempted on a registry key that has been marked for deletion.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_LOG_SPACE
rows.description: The system could not allocate the required space in a registry log.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_SIDS
rows.description: Too many SIDs have been specified.

rows.name: STATUS_LM_CROSS_ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED
rows.description: An attempt was made to change a user password in the security account manager without providing the necessary LM cross-encrypted password.

rows.name: STATUS_KEY_HAS_CHILDREN
rows.description: An attempt was made to create a symbolic link in a registry key that already has subkeys or values.

rows.name: STATUS_CHILD_MUST_BE_VOLATILE
rows.description: An attempt was made to create a stable subkey under a volatile parent key.

rows.name: STATUS_DEVICE_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
rows.description: The I/O device is configured incorrectly or the configuration parameters to the driver are incorrect.

rows.name: STATUS_DRIVER_INTERNAL_ERROR
rows.description: An error was detected between two drivers or within an I/O driver.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_DEVICE_STATE
rows.description: The device is not in a valid state to perform this request.

rows.name: STATUS_IO_DEVICE_ERROR
rows.description: The I/O device reported an I/O error.

rows.name: STATUS_DEVICE_PROTOCOL_ERROR
rows.description: A protocol error was detected between the driver and the device.

rows.name: STATUS_BACKUP_CONTROLLER
rows.description: This operation is only allowed for the primary domain controller of the domain.

rows.name: STATUS_LOG_FILE_FULL
rows.description: The log file space is insufficient to support this operation.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_LATE
rows.description: A write operation was attempted to a volume after it was dismounted.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_TRUST_LSA_SECRET
rows.description: The workstation does not have a trust secret for the primary domain in the local LSA database.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_TRUST_SAM_ACCOUNT
rows.description: On applicable Windows Server releases, the SAM database does not have a computer account for this workstation trust relationship.

rows.name: STATUS_TRUSTED_DOMAIN_FAILURE
rows.description: The logon request failed because the trust relationship between the primary domain and the trusted domain failed.

rows.name: STATUS_TRUSTED_RELATIONSHIP_FAILURE
rows.description: The logon request failed because the trust relationship between this workstation and the primary domain failed.

rows.name: STATUS_EVENTLOG_FILE_CORRUPT
rows.description: The Eventlog log file is corrupt.

rows.name: STATUS_EVENTLOG_CANT_START
rows.description: No Eventlog log file could be opened. The Eventlog service did not start.

rows.name: STATUS_TRUST_FAILURE
rows.description: The network logon failed. This might be because the validation authority cannot be reached.

rows.name: STATUS_MUTANT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
rows.description: An attempt was made to acquire a mutant such that its maximum count would have been exceeded.

rows.name: STATUS_NETLOGON_NOT_STARTED
rows.description: An attempt was made to logon, but the NetLogon service was not started.

rows.name: STATUS_ACCOUNT_EXPIRED
rows.description: The user account has expired.

rows.name: STATUS_POSSIBLE_DEADLOCK
rows.description: {EXCEPTION} Possible deadlock condition.

rows.name: STATUS_NETWORK_CREDENTIAL_CONFLICT
rows.description: Multiple connections to a server or shared resource by the same user, using more than one user name, are not allowed. Disconnect all previous connections to the server or shared resource and try again.

rows.name: STATUS_REMOTE_SESSION_LIMIT
rows.description: An attempt was made to establish a session to a network server, but there are already too many sessions established to that server.

rows.name: STATUS_EVENTLOG_FILE_CHANGED
rows.description: The log file has changed between reads.

rows.name: STATUS_NOLOGON_INTERDOMAIN_TRUST_ACCOUNT
rows.description: The account used is an interdomain trust account. Use your global user account or local user account to access this server.

rows.name: STATUS_NOLOGON_WORKSTATION_TRUST_ACCOUNT
rows.description: The account used is a computer account. Use your global user account or local user account to access this server.

rows.name: STATUS_NOLOGON_SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT
rows.description: The account used is a server trust account. Use your global user account or local user account to access this server.

rows.name: STATUS_DOMAIN_TRUST_INCONSISTENT
rows.description: The name or SID of the specified domain is inconsistent with the trust information for that domain.

rows.name: STATUS_FS_DRIVER_REQUIRED
rows.description: A volume has been accessed for which a file system driver is required that has not yet been loaded.

rows.name: STATUS_IMAGE_ALREADY_LOADED_AS_DLL
rows.description: Indicates that the specified image is already loaded as a DLL.

rows.name: STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_GLOBAL_SHORT_NAME_REGISTRY_SETTING
rows.description: Short name settings cannot be changed on this volume due to the global registry setting.

rows.name: STATUS_SHORT_NAMES_NOT_ENABLED_ON_VOLUME
rows.description: Short names are not enabled on this volume.

rows.name: STATUS_SECURITY_STREAM_IS_INCONSISTENT
rows.description: The security stream for the given volume is in an inconsistent state. Please run CHKDSK on the volume.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_LOCK_RANGE
rows.description: A requested file lock operation cannot be processed due to an invalid byte range.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_ACE_CONDITION
rows.description: The specified access control entry (ACE) contains an invalid condition.

rows.name: STATUS_IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_NOT_PRESENT
rows.description: The subsystem needed to support the image type is not present.

rows.name: STATUS_NOTIFICATION_GUID_ALREADY_DEFINED
rows.description: The specified file already has a notification GUID associated with it.

rows.name: STATUS_NETWORK_OPEN_RESTRICTION
rows.description: A remote open failed because the network open restrictions were not satisfied.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_USER_SESSION_KEY
rows.description: There is no user session key for the specified logon session.

rows.name: STATUS_USER_SESSION_DELETED
rows.description: The remote user session has been deleted.

rows.name: STATUS_RESOURCE_LANG_NOT_FOUND
rows.description: Indicates the specified resource language ID cannot be found in the image file.

rows.name: STATUS_INSUFF_SERVER_RESOURCES
rows.description: Insufficient server resources exist to complete the request.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_BUFFER_SIZE
rows.description: The size of the buffer is invalid for the specified operation.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_ADDRESS_COMPONENT
rows.description: The transport rejected the specified network address as invalid.

rows.name: STATUS_INVALID_ADDRESS_WILDCARD
rows.description: The transport rejected the specified network address due to invalid use of a wildcard.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_ADDRESSES
rows.description: The transport address could not be opened because all the available addresses are in use.

rows.name: STATUS_ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS
rows.description: The transport address could not be opened because it already exists.

rows.name: STATUS_ADDRESS_CLOSED
rows.description: The transport address is now closed.

rows.name: STATUS_CONNECTION_DISCONNECTED
rows.description: The transport connection is now disconnected.

rows.name: STATUS_CONNECTION_RESET
rows.description: The transport connection has been reset.

rows.name: STATUS_TOO_MANY_NODES
rows.description: The transport cannot dynamically acquire any more nodes.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_ABORTED
rows.description: The transport aborted a pending transaction.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_TIMED_OUT
rows.description: The transport timed out a request that is waiting for a response.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_NO_RELEASE
rows.description: The transport did not receive a release for a pending response.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_NO_MATCH
rows.description: The transport did not find a transaction that matches the specific token.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_RESPONDED
rows.description: The transport had previously responded to a transaction request.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_INVALID_ID
rows.description: The transport does not recognize the specified transaction request ID.

rows.name: STATUS_TRANSACTION_INVALID_TYPE
rows.description: The transport does not recognize the specified transaction request type.

rows.name: STATUS_NOT_SERVER_SESSION
rows.description: The transport can only process the specified request on the server side of a session.

rows.name: STATUS_NOT_CLIENT_SESSION
rows.description: The transport can only process the specified request on the client side of a session.

rows.name: STATUS_CANNOT_LOAD_REGISTRY_FILE
rows.description: {Registry File Failure} The registry cannot load the hive (file): %hs or its log or alternate. It is corrupt, absent, or not writable.

rows.name: STATUS_DEBUG_ATTACH_FAILED
rows.description: {Unexpected Failure in DebugActiveProcess} An unexpected failure occurred while processing a DebugActiveProcess API request. Choosing OK will terminate the process, and choosing Cancel will ignore the error.

rows.name: STATUS_SYSTEM_PROCESS_TERMINATED
rows.description: {Fatal System Error} The %hs system process terminated unexpectedly with a status of 0x%08x (0x%08x 0x%08x). The system has been shut down.

rows.name: STATUS_DATA_NOT_ACCEPTED
rows.description: {Data Not Accepted} The TDI client could not handle the data received during an indication.

rows.name: STATUS_NO_BROWSER_SERVERS_FOUND
rows.description: {Unable to Retrieve Browser Server List} The list of servers for this workgroup is not currently available.

rows.name: STATUS_VDM_HARD_ERROR
rows.description: NTVDM encountered a hard error.

rows.name: STATUS_DRIVER_CANCEL_TIMEOUT
rows.description: {Cancel Timeout} The driver %hs failed to complete a canceled I/O request in the allotted time.

rows.name: STATUS_REPLY_MESSAGE_MISMATCH
rows.description: {Reply Message Mismatch} An attempt was made to reply to an LPC message, but the thread specified by the client ID in the message was not waiting on that message.

rows.name: STATUS_MAPPED_ALIGNMENT
rows.description: {Mapped View Alignment Incorrect} An attempt was made to map a view of a file, but either the specified base address or the offset into the file were not aligned on the proper allocation granularity.

rows.name: STATUS_IMAGE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
